articles.title: Standalone Total Revenue up by 18.4% at Rs.19,206 Crore
articles.source_name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd - press release filed with NSE/BSE
articles.facts_summary: For Q2 FY2027 (quarter to 30 Sep 2026) standalone revenue was Rs 19,206 crore (+18.4% y/y) and PAT Rs 804 crore (+7.6%); consolidated revenue was Rs 19,644 crore. DMart added 15 stores in the quarter, reaching 518 stores and 21.4 million sq ft.

articles.title: Company Update at the end of Quarter 2 (Q2) of Financial Year 2026-27
articles.facts_summary: Standalone revenue from operations for the September 2026 quarter was Rs 19,206.18 crore versus Rs 16,218.79 crore a year earlier; the store count stood at 518, including one Navi Mumbai store closed for reconstruction.

articles.title: Change in Management - 11.07.2026
articles.facts_summary: The board approved re-appointing Bhaskaran N as Whole-time Director and COO (17 Oct 2026 to 31 May 2028, subject to shareholder approval), appointed Lalit Ahuja as Chief Operating Officer from 13 Jul 2026, and moved Parvez Vandrewala to Head - Centre of Excellence from 1 Nov 2026.

articles.title: Standalone Total Revenue up by 19.0% at Rs.17,205 Crore
articles.source_name: Avenue Supermarts Ltd - press release filed with NSE/BSE
articles.facts_summary: FY2026 consolidated revenue was Rs 68,821 crore (FY2025: Rs 59,358 crore) and consolidated net profit Rs 2,970 crore; 85 stores were added to reach 500. DMart Ready exited one city and operated in 18 cities at 31 Mar 2026.

articles.title: Change in Management - 02.05.2026
articles.facts_summary: Independent director Chandrashekhar Bhave's second term ended on 16 May 2026, and several senior-management roles changed from 2 May 2026, including a combined Chief Business Officer role for pharmacy and food services.

articles.title: MR DIY 2Q26 net profit falls to RM134.4mil
articles.facts_summary: Q2 FY2026 net profit was RM134.40 million versus RM158.58 million a year earlier, while revenue rose to RM1.25 billion from RM1.21 billion; the network had 1,610 stores at 30 Jun 2026.

articles.title: MR D.I.Y POSTS STRONGEST 1Q PERFORMANCE
articles.source_name: MR D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad - press release
articles.facts_summary: Q1 FY2026 revenue rose 9.3% to RM1.4 billion and profit after tax 10.3% to RM192 million; the release cites 1,584 stores, up 7.7% from 1,471 a year earlier.

articles.title: Proposed Establishment Of The Sukuk Wakalah Programmes
articles.source_name: MR D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad - Bursa announcement (IR mirror)
articles.facts_summary: The company proposed Islamic medium-term note and commercial paper programmes with a combined RM5 billion limit, rated AA1/P1 by RAM, for uses including refinancing, working capital, capex and acquisitions.

articles.title: MR D.I.Y. raises RM540mil via inaugural sukuk, IMTN oversubscribed 5.6 times
articles.facts_summary: MR D.I.Y. raised RM540 million in its inaugural sukuk issuance; the IMTN was reported as 5.6 times oversubscribed.

articles.title: REPORTS STRONG 4Q RESULTS, DOUBLE-DIGIT PROFIT GROWTH
articles.source_name: MR D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad - press release
articles.facts_summary: FY2025 revenue was about RM5.0 billion and profit RM632.7 million; total dividends for the year were RM758.0 million, a 119.8% payout.

articles.title: Change In Boardroom - Mr Tan Yu Yeh
articles.source_name: MR D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad - Bursa announcement (IR mirror)
articles.facts_summary: Founder Tan Yu Yeh stepped down as Executive Vice Chairman effective 17 Apr 2025 to take an advisory role; Tan Shie Haur joined the board as a non-independent non-executive director.

articles.title: Wellness Forever files DRHP to raise Rs 1500-1600 crore
articles.facts_summary: Wellness Forever Medicare filed a DRHP with SEBI for an IPO combining a Rs 400 crore fresh issue with an offer for sale of about 1.6 crore shares; stores had grown from 144 in March 2019 to 236 across 23 cities in Maharashtra, Goa and Karnataka.

articles.title: Wellness Forever gets Sebi nod for an IPO
articles.facts_summary: SEBI approved the proposed IPO; the report cites FY2021 revenue of Rs 924.02 crore versus Rs 863.25 crore in FY2020, with IIFL, Ambit, DAM Capital and HDFC Bank as book-running lead managers.

articles.title: Wellness Forever Medicare Limited - Rating downgraded to 'Crisil BBB/Stable'
articles.facts_summary: CRISIL downgraded Rs 294.17 crore of bank facilities to BBB/Stable from BBB+/Negative, citing weaker-than-expected FY2025 operating performance; it reported provisional FY2025 operating income of Rs 1,563 crore and a loss of Rs 43 crore, with about 375 outlets.

articles.title: Presentation for Earnings Call with Analysts/Institutional Investors on Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
articles.source_name: MedPlus Health Services Ltd - exchange filing
articles.facts_summary: Q1 FY2027 revenue rose 21.8% to Rs 18,796 million while operating EBITDA was Rs 651 million (3.5% margin) and PAT Rs 331.7 million; the network had 5,476 stores at 30 Jun 2026 (4,812 company-owned, 664 franchisee).

articles.title: Medplus Health Services shares tumble to 52-week low after weak Q1 FY27; Nomura maintains 'Buy', check target price
articles.facts_summary: The stock fell as much as 17.8% intraday to Rs 653.80 after the Q1 FY2027 results; Nomura kept a Buy rating with a Rs 1,190 target.

articles.title: Earnings Presentation on the Audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026
articles.source_name: Vishal Mega Mart Ltd - exchange filing (BSE, via Business Standard mirror)
articles.facts_summary: FY2026 revenue grew 20.4% and PAT 32.8%; the company had 795 stores in 535 cities at 31 Mar 2026.

articles.title: Vishal Mega Mart Reports Q1 Profit At ₹258.77 Crore, Revenue Rises To ₹3,727.01 Crore
articles.facts_summary: Q1 FY2027 profit was Rs 258.77 crore on revenue of Rs 3,727.01 crore; the board also proposed capping aggregate foreign ownership at 49.99%, subject to shareholder approval.

articles.title: 99 HOLDINGS RECORDS 24.3% NORMALISED PAT GROWTH IN Q4FYE2025 AND 19.9% FOR FYE2025
articles.source_name: 99 Speed Mart Retail Holdings Berhad - press release
articles.facts_summary: FY2025 revenue reached about RM11.4 billion and the network 3,037 outlets; the profit figures in this release were pre-audit and were later revised.

articles.title: 99 Speed Mart's net profits increased 13pct on outlet network expansion
articles.facts_summary: Q2 FY2026 net profit rose to RM163.95 million and the outlet network reached 3,151.
